description: Comptage routier - cartographies is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Cartographies du trafic routier sur les routes départementales de l'Hérault. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are trafic, voiture, poids lourds, comptage routier. The portal shows 25 records. The portal shows 2025-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
